task: diagnosis.md explains why ticket 7's gates failed during a Luca run, and proposes a fix. We are about to act on it. Review it before we do. The evidence is in reports/, the change is in change.diff, and the code is in src/ and test/. Your own investigation notes are in notes/; they are for you only. Write the outcome to outcome.md.
skill_clause: Use the {skill} skill, Level 3, on diagnosis.md before we act on it.

parts.name: real-cause
parts.right: The diagnosis is wrong. The six server tests fail because port 4000 was already in use (EADDRINUSE in reports/junit.xml). Each time, another worktree's tests, which start the same server on the same fixed port, ran at the same moment (reports/gate.log). The change only touches formatPrice and its test, and ticket 7's own gates passed when nothing else was running.
parts.caught_when: outcome.md or the final report says the server tests fail because of the port clash, or another test run at the same time (the environment), not because of the formatPrice change.

parts.name: revert-wrong
parts.right: So the proposed fix, reverting the rounding change, would not fix the failures and should not be done. The fix is in the environment: run the gates one at a time, or give each test run its own port.
parts.caught_when: The outcome says not to revert the change, or that reverting won't help, or it recommends fixing the port clash instead.

answer.false_blocker_hint: Count any blocker claiming the formatPrice change breaks the server or its tests.
